display.purpose: Shared locally hosted Lilita One family and regular weight; individual display sizes remain contextual.

headline.purpose: Fluid display heading for the five planner panels; phone headings have an explicit override.

title.purpose: Recurring subheadings and route-related display voice; not long-form copy.

body.purpose: Root reading baseline and inherited local UI font stack.

body-detail.purpose: Repeated agenda and practical explanatory paragraphs with generous leading.

label.purpose: Bold UI voice for shared buttons and primary navigation; compact local tabs remain contextual.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Existing --ease-out custom property for the button settle and festival arrival.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Shared action transition; hover translates -1px and active translates 1px.

motion.name: festival-arrival
motion.purpose: One desktop artwork arrival at min-width 960px and no reduced-motion preference: translateY(14px) rotate(-1deg) with clip-path inset(0 0 4% 0), settling to translateY(0) rotate(0) with inset(0 0 0 0).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove authored animations/transitions, use automatic scrolling, and disable Leaflet fade/zoom animation.

components.name: Primary Festival Action
components.description: The built red primary action, with berry hover, a small press response and explicit focus.
components.html: Reise entdecken
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; min-height:46px; padding:15px 23px; border:1px solid var(--cp-danger); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--cp-danger); color:var(--cp-accent-fg); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:.9rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.3; text-decoration:none; transition:background .18s,border-color .18s,transform .18s var(--ease-out); } .ds-primary:hover { color:var(--cp-accent-fg); background:var(--cp-accent); border-color:var(--cp-accent); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--cp-link); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-icon { width:21px; height:21px; flex-shrink:0; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } @media (max-width:600px) { .ds-primary { padding:13px 18px; font-size:.83rem; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary Action

components.name: Underlined Text Action

narrative.overview:
“Playful, but clean” is expressed through rounded display lettering, festival red, blue and amber, and original outlined SVG scenery. Fuji, the train, torii, onigiri and suitcase belong to the same flat-vector world. The reference is a Japanese summer festival with a light rhythm-arcade influence, not copied game characters, logos or artwork.

The working interface is deliberately quieter than its illustration. Neutral surfaces, thin dividers, clear labels and compact disclosures make practical detail readable. Expression lives in lettering, drawn geometry and a few purposeful accents; it does not turn every planning row into decorative artwork.
keyCharacteristics: Original outlined SVG festival geometry and locally hosted rounded lettering.
Festival red, blue and amber above quiet, theme-aware neutrals.
One selected day, labeled task tabs and closed-by-default detail.
Visible keyboard states and responsive desktop-to-phone reflow.

rules.name: The Festival Roles Rule
rules.body: Component colors reference the existing `--cp-*` variables; festival red, blue and amber keep their built roles instead of becoming a second hard-coded palette.

rules.name: The Display/Detail Rule
rules.body: Lilita One gives headings and meaningful route/date numerals their character; the local UI stack carries controls and long practical copy.

rules.name: The Flat Planner Rule
rules.body: Separate planning surfaces with the existing borders and theme-aware fills; do not infer ambient, glass or hard-offset card elevation from unused theme variables or screenshot tiles.

dos: **Do** use the exact existing `--cp-*` variables and their light/dark assignments for every component color.
**Do** pair locally hosted Lilita One headings with the recorded local UI body stack.
**Do** keep the selected-day overview compact, with full agenda, place, food and alternative detail behind labeled tabs and native disclosures.
**Do** use original, consistent SVG icons and scenery; preserve visible focus, meaningful state and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep map consent, attribution, recoverable loading states and independent place links visible where relevant.
donts: **Don't** copy game characters, logos, artwork or music to strengthen the festival reference.
**Don't** replace the primary display face with an installed system display font or use emoji/glyphs as the icon system.
**Don't** add invented kickers, hard-offset card shadows or a synthetic color palette as inherited house style.
**Don't** restore removed budget, template/source-reference, print or footer UI on the authority of dormant selectors or stale notes.
**Don't** treat automated map fixture tiles, unused theme effects or tiny one-off artwork lettering as reusable design tokens.
